text:
alex: Heads-up — thinking about adding per-key QoS tags in the auth proxy so we can route premium keys to low-latency pools and charge accordingly. Thoughts?
ciara: Interested. How would this differ from existing project-affinity tags?
sam: I'd keep it orthogonal — key-level QoS can override project defaults for spikes. Need fallback rules.
jordan: Concern: will this blow up our telemetry cardinality? :grimacing: 
alex: Good call. Plan is to add a bounded enum (standard, priority, realtime) not freeform labels.
ciara: +1 to enum. Also need console UX for setting it per service account.
alex: UX can default to inherited project tag, with a toggle to override.
sam: Ops question — how do we enforce SLA? circuit-break to cheaper pool when quota exhausted?
lina: Telemetry: we should emit key.qos and key.billing_tier as top-level fields. Keep raw log sample rate at 1% though.
jordan: If we do 1% raw, we still need aggregated counts at 100% for cost. So statsd counters per qos.
alex: Agreed. proposal: counters: requests.{qos}.{model}.{status} and tokens.{qos}.{model}. We'll store high-cardinality agg only for the qos enum.
ciara: Also need to ensure tags propagate through routing: header X-Redwood-QoS or claim in JWT?
sam: Prefer JWT claim for offline enforcement, header for edge quick checks. Both ok if we canonicalize.
alex: Example config sketch:```yaml
auth_proxy:
  qos_levels: ["standard","priority","realtime"]
  default_policy: "inherit_project"
  canary_percent: 5
```
alex: Canary plan: auth-proxy flag + console opt-in, start at 5% keys for 48h, monitor latency + errors.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: auth-proxy-qos flag rollout (build 4591)
infra-bot: canary reached 5% target in prod-canary.
ciara: How about billing mapping? We need to tie qos enum to pricing rate in billing service, and update invoice line items.
alex: Billing change needs API: `POST /billing/v1/tiers {"qos":"realtime","multiplier":2.5}` — but schedule effective date next billing run.
sam: Agree, avoid mid-cycle invoice churn. Add a migration script to map historical usage to tiers.
jordan: Tests: unit + e2e. Add load test that targets qos=priority route.
lina: Dashboards: p95 latency by qos, cost per 1k tokens by qos, error rate by qos. Also alert if cost delta > 20% in 24h.
ciara: I'll sketch console wireframe today — per-service-account setting with inherit toggle + explanation tooltip.
alex: Owners: @alex, @ciara, @sam. Action items: PR for proxy (auth-proxy feature flag), telemetry changes (emit key.qos, statsd counters), billing API PR, console wireframe. Merge target: EOW.
sam: Ack.
ciara: will post follow-up with wireframes and sample queries.
alex: Thanks team :tada:
